title: Module Context Configuration v2
description: Schema for context.yaml of a module. Unified v2: merges engine fields (objective, users, risks) with graph fields (views, surfaces, base_route) and adds graph-navigation metadata (tags, critical_path, owner, health_status, related_modules).

_version.description: Schema version for evolution tracking. Use '2' for files conforming to this unified schema.

module.description: Module identifier. Must match the directory name under .qa/modules/.

description.description: Short human-readable description of the module's purpose. Used as the primary label in the knowledge graph.

objective.description: Primary business objective or goal of this module. More detailed than description.

base_route.description: Root URL path for this module (e.g. '/auth', '/simulation'). Used as the entry point in the graph.

views.description: Hierarchical list of UI views exposed by this module. Each view can contain nested surfaces (tabs, modals, drawers, sections).

id.description: Unique identifier for this view within the module.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the view.

surfaces.description: Nested UI surfaces within the view (tabs, modals, drawers, sections).

users.description: List of user types or roles involved in this module (e.g. 'anonymous', 'authenticated-user', 'admin').

routes.description: Flat list of all routes or paths covered by this module. Use views[].path for structured data.

risks.description: List of identified QA risks for this module.

notes.description: Additional implementation notes or context for QA engineers.

sensitive_selectors.description: CSS selectors targeting sensitive data (passwords, PII, tax IDs, etc.). These will be masked during test execution.

manually_edited.description: True if this context file has been manually reviewed or edited by a human engineer.

prd_source.description: Reference to the Product Requirements Document (file path, URL, or ticket ID).

tags.description: Semantic tags for grouping modules in the knowledge graph (e.g. ['security', 'payments', 'onboarding']). Used to apply visual clusters in the graph viewer.

critical_path.description: If true, this module is part of the primary user journey (critical path). The graph viewer will visually highlight these nodes.

owner.description: Team or individual responsible for this module (e.g. 'auth-squad', 'payments-team').

health_status.description: Current operational health of this module. 'healthy' = tests passing, 'degraded' = some failures, 'unknown' = no recent executions. Drives node color in the graph.

related_modules.description: Explicit cross-module relationships not captured by prereqs.yaml or flows. These become 'related' edges in the knowledge graph.
